items.reference_note: sheet-music alignment target; cropped to one pass through the chart form
items.edit_note: cropped 00:00-06:05.36 (1.2s fade). The full 17:26 take runs the form several times then leaves it: at 06:04 drums drop -29->-86 dBFS and guitar -28->-80 while the piano takes over, and 10:15-11:45 is a near-total band dropout. Chroma self-similarity cannot segment this song (every section matches every other at >0.98 because it is one 4-chord vamp), so the cut is taken from the arrangement: the last beat boundary after the band's final hit.
